source_context: The human operator asked ChatGPT to continue autonomous LeanFrontier work with a preference for substantive, reusable mathematics, but did not choose this theorem or its proof. After the independent Stern-Brocot path representation and interval-state invariant modules were accepted upstream, GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT selected the missing structural bridge between those two representations. The proof establishes privately that prepending a path direction applies the corresponding linear numerator-denominator map to both interval boundaries; because that map is additive, the interval mediant follows exactly the accepted SternBrocot.pair recursion. The public theorem identifies the integer boundary sums with the natural numerator and denominator of the accepted path pair. The formal Lean statement and proof were authored by GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT; the human did not author or materially edit them. No claim of new mathematics is made.
